2610.02886.title: Misinformation Without Triggers: From Factual Answers to Downstream Decisions
2610.02886.paper_summary: Language models learn from web documents, some of them false, and false content can reach a model's answer to a factual question and the summaries and decisions that use it. Most data-poisoning studies add a trigger to the training data and activate it in the prompt. False documents can also change factual responses without any trigger, but we do not know whether the direct answer predicts the decision. In this work, we follow false content past the answer and find an \emph{audit gap} between what a direct probe reports and what the model then does, comparing false training with matched truthful controls in a controlled decision task, \emph{Guess the Capital}, where a fixed decoder turns factual answers into a scored card choice, and on a misleading claim from Facebook posts about the 2019--20 Australian bushfires. Across eight models at dose 1,000, direct injected-choice rates reach 95.8--100\%, while injected game choices increase by 1.7--14.4 percentage points over matched truthful training. The gap runs the other way too. Facts that pass the direct probe still push decisions toward the injected answer, and game accuracy drops further than those choices explain. Truthful correction brings the fact back but not the decisions built on it. We then look into the real-world bushfire case, models trained on the false posts say that people were arrested for arson even when they lose the inflated count, and in a count-by-wording factorial the misleading arrest wording produces arrest assertions even when the training count stays at 24. In simpler terms, \textbf{a correct factual answer does not guarantee a correct decision, and losing the injected number does not remove the misleading story}.
2610.02886.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型從網頁文件中學習，其中一些是虛假的，而虛假內容可能影響模型對事實問題的回答以及使用該回答的摘要和決策。大多數數據中毒研究會在訓練數據中添加觸發器並在提示中激活它。虛假文件也可以在沒有任何觸發器的情況下改變事實回應，但我們不知道直接回答是否能預測決策。在這項工作中，我們跟踪虛假內容超越回答，發現直接探測報告與模型隨後的行為之間存在一個\emph{審計差距}，比較虛假訓練與受控決策任務中的真實對照，\emph{猜首都}，在這裡固定解碼器將事實回答轉換為得分的卡片選擇，並針對來自Facebook帖子關於2019-20年澳大利亞叢林大火的誤導性聲明。在劑量1,000的八個模型中，直接注入選擇率達到95.8-100\%，而注入的遊戲選擇比匹配的真實訓練增加了1.7-14.4個百分點。這個差距也反向存在。通過直接探測的事實仍然推動決策朝向注入的答案，而遊戲準確率的下降超過了這些選擇所能解釋的範圍。真實的修正將事實帶回，但不會改變基於此的決策。我們接著研究現實世界的叢林大火案例，訓練在虛假帖子上的模型表示，即使失去膨脹的數字，人們仍然因縱火被逮捕，而在一個按措辭計數的因子中，誤導性的逮捕措辭即使在訓練計數保持在24時也會產生逮捕主張。簡而言之，\textbf{正確的事實回答並不保證正確的決策，而失去注入的數字並不會消除誤導性的故事}。
